subject: Shiny-server, regular expressions to map url

messages.author: d6f9c6ff776783d5
messages.subject: Shiny-server, regular expressions to map url
parts:
Hi,

I'm using shiny-server to management some apps, and I want know if it's possible use regular expressions to map urls in shiny-server.conf, like this:

I have some apps that begin with the same name "abcd" but continue with other character "abcd1", "abcd2".... so, when I put those, in the shiny-server.conf, can I use location with regular expresion?

        location /abcd?{
            site_dir /var/shiny-server/www;
        }

what do I want ? I want to redirect with site_dir all of my apps that begin with "abcd" 


Thanks for all!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny-server, regular expressions to map url
parts: Hmmm, that will not work. Could you consider doing /abcd?n=1 instead?

Thanks for the answer joe, but it doesn't work,

I don't know what can be the problem, I'm going to explain what is exactly my problem and may be you can help me with other solution, first I have a management of server that is a shiny-App, this app going to create multiple thread of other shiny-app, because I need to use multiples process in parallel of the same shiny-app, so when create a thread of app with the management, redirect the client to the other url where is mapping a thread of shiny-app. 

All of this is working fine, but I need that shiny-server always when put in the browser the url, redirect to the same shiny-app (The management app), so how am I doing it ? with regular expression, on the next form:

  shiny-server.conf
  
  run_as shiny;
  log_dir /var/shiny-server/log;

  server{
    listen 80 172.23.177.37;
    location /{
      site_dir /var/shiny-server/www/managment_server;
    }

    location /sipgo?n=1{
      site_dir /var/shiny-server/www;
    }
  }


somebody know, how can I do it in other form? or may be, do you think that I have any problem?

once again, thank you kindly.

messages.author: 9711d30301c32133
messages.subject: Re: Shiny-server, regular expressions to map url
parts:
Hi Ricardo,

Unfortunately, I'm not sure of a great way to solve this problem in the Open Source Shiny Server. The good news is that we have this exact feature (multiple processes per Shiny app) in our Shiny Server Pro offering. In Pro, you can define in the configuration how many processes you want running for each application (among other things), so you don't have to worry about mapping different "shinyApp1" URLs to different processes.

We'll be doing a new round of Beta testing for this product in the near future. You can contact tar...@rstudio.com if you're interested in participating. If I'm misunderstanding what you're trying to accomplish with your regex, feel free to try us again!

Jeff
